source_evidence: These benefits can include tax deductions (e.g., pre-tax contributions), tax-deferred growth (no taxes until withdrawal), and/or tax-free withdrawals.
question: Misconception: Every retirement account provides the same tax benefit, including tax-free withdrawals.
answer: Retirement accounts can have different tax benefits. Some may offer tax deductions, tax-deferred growth, tax-free withdrawals, or a combination; the source does not say every account offers all of them.
